name: Mud house under thatch (our own design)
about: Made by tools/battle-models/asia (scenery). Metres; x east, y right, z up from the ground at its foot. Stands still: `sway` (0 to 1, point by point) is how far the wind moves each point; nothing else moves. Looks only: the battle's ground decides cover and passage. Paints: 0 stone, 1 wood_dark, 2 opening, 3 mud, 4 mud_dark, 5 thatch, 6 thatch_old, 7 thatch_under
